days.title: Castelletta and the Rossa Gorge
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: eremo di Grottafucile
stops.detail: Inside the park there is also the hermitage of Grottafucile, overlooking the Rossa Gorge, near the village of Castelletta.

stops.name: Gola della Rossa
stops.detail: The beauty of the Rossa Gorge is threatened by the continuous opening of quarries, the impact of which seems not to be sufficiently considered by local political environments.

days.title: Genga Caves and Temples
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Grotte di Frasassi
stops.detail: Extending for approximately 9170 hectares on the Apennine side of the province of Ancona, the park directly concerns the municipalities of Serra San Quirico, Genga (with the well-known Frasassi Caves), Arcevia, Cerreto d'Esi and Fabriano, a territory still immersed in an intact and lush nature.

stops.name: tempio del Valadier
stops.detail: Other points of interest are the famous Valadier temple and the hermitage of Santa Maria Infra Saxa, along the Frasassi Gorge, near Genga.
